text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That fell just a bit short, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had had just a gentle push of a 
breeze, perhaps I might have reached it, 
but..."
choice_data_list: It wasn't that bad of a run.

Next time, let's go for the win without 
relying on the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that means the world to 
me."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, if things stay like this, I won't 
be satisfied either.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I myself will whip up a tempest 
on the course.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of being pushed by the wind, I 
must have the resolve to charge forward as 
the wind itself...!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about it that way got me 
motivated. Let's do our best toward what 
comes next!"
